Dialogue 07: Importance of Tree Plantation

↑ ডায়ালগ সূচি

বোর্ড রেফারেন্স: Dhaka Board '17, '22; Cumilla Board '18; Dinajpur Board '19; Barishal Board '23 • Top Priority

চরিত্র ও প্রেক্ষাপট: Two Friends — Role of trees in maintaining ecological balance, preventing soil erosion, and fighting global warming.

পূর্ণাঙ্গ প্রমিত সংলাপ স্ক্রিপ্ট (Model Conversational Script):

Sakib: Hello Tahmid, what are you doing with those small saplings in your garden?

Tahmid: Hello Sakib! I am planting fruit and timber saplings around our courtyard.

Sakib: That is wonderful! But why are people emphasizing tree plantation so urgently nowadays?

Tahmid: Because trees are our greatest life-savers. Without trees, human existence on Earth would be entirely impossible.

Sakib: Could you elaborate on how trees maintain our ecological balance?

Tahmid: Trees absorb poisonous carbon dioxide from the atmosphere and release pure oxygen, which we breathe every second.

Sakib: They also provide us with food, timber, and medicinal herbs, don't they?

Tahmid: Yes! Beyond that, trees prevent soil erosion, shield our coastal belt from deadly cyclones, and induce rainfall to prevent droughts.

Sakib: Yet reckless deforestation is destroying our forests at an alarming rate across the globe.

Tahmid: That is why global warming, erratic weather, and rising sea levels are threatening our country so severely.

Sakib: What should we do as responsible students to counter this disaster?

Tahmid: We must observe tree plantation weeks, plant trees in every empty space around our homes and schools, and motivate our community.

Sakib: I will join you right now and plant three saplings in my backyard as well!

Tahmid: Wonderful decision, Sakib. Let us make our Mother Earth green again.

↑ উপরে ডায়ালগ সূচিতে ফিরুন

Dialogue 08: Importance of Learning English in the Modern World

↑ ডায়ালগ সূচি

বোর্ড রেফারেন্স: Rajshahi Board '18; Chattogram Board '18; Sylhet Board '19; Jashore Board '23 • Top Priority

চরিত্র ও প্রেক্ষাপট: Two Classmates — English as a global passport for higher education, overseas jobs, and ICT careers.

পূর্ণাঙ্গ প্রমিত সংলাপ স্ক্রিপ্ট (Model Conversational Script):

Kamal: Hello Jamal, where are you rushing off to in such a hurry?

Jamal: Hello Kamal. I am heading to my spoken English club.

Kamal: Spoken English? Why are you dedicating so much extra time to English when we already study it at school?

Jamal: Because English is not merely an academic examination subject; it is the universal international language of the modern world.

Kamal: In what ways is English indispensable for our future career?

Jamal: English is the global passport. More than eighty percent of the world's scientific, technological, and medical research is published in English.

Kamal: What about higher education and overseas employment?

Jamal: If you wish to pursue higher degrees at prestigious domestic or foreign universities, proficiency in English is an absolute prerequisite.

Kamal: Furthermore, in multinational corporations, IT sectors, and international commerce, English is the primary medium of communication.

Jamal: Exactly! Even online freelancing and international outsourcing require fluent English communication skills.

Kamal: Without a solid command of English, a person remains isolated from the modern global knowledge economy.

Jamal: You have summarized it perfectly. Would you like to join our spoken English practice session today?

Kamal: Yes, I would love to! Let us walk together toward the club.

Dialogue 09: How to Eradicate Illiteracy from Bangladesh

↑ ডায়ালগ সূচি

বোর্ড রেফারেন্স: Jashore Board '17; Barishal Board '19; Mymensingh Board '22 • High Priority

চরিত্র ও প্রেক্ষাপট: Two Friends — Illiteracy as a curse; advocating night schools, adult education, and free primary education.

পূর্ণাঙ্গ প্রমিত সংলাপ স্ক্রিপ্ট (Model Conversational Script):

Rana: Hello Ripon, what were you discussing with our headmaster earlier today?

Ripon: Hello Rana. We were discussing the problem of illiteracy in our neighboring village and how we can organize a youth campaign to eradicate it.

Rana: Illiteracy is indeed one of the gravest curses holding our country back from true development.

Ripon: You are completely right. An illiterate person is like a blind individual in a civilized society, unable to read basic notices or understand civic rights.

Rana: How does illiteracy directly impede our economic progress?

Ripon: Illiterate citizens struggle to adopt modern agricultural technology, hygiene practices, and vocational training, keeping poverty alive.

Rana: What practical measures should we undertake to eradicate this curse?

Ripon: First, primary education must be enforced strictly so that no child drops out of school due to poverty.

Rana: What about adults who missed schooling in their childhood?

Ripon: We should set up free night schools in village primary school buildings where educated youths like us can teach them basic reading, writing, and arithmetic.

Rana: That is a noble initiative! We can also distribute free books and conduct community awareness meetings.

Ripon: The government, non-governmental organizations, and students must unite like an army to wipe out illiteracy.

Rana: Count me in, Ripon. I will gladly volunteer my evenings to teach at the night school!

Dialogue 10: Merits and Demerits of Mobile Phones / Smartphones

↑ ডায়ালগ সূচি

বোর্ড রেফারেন্স: Dinajpur Board '18; Cumilla Board '20; Dhaka Board '25 • Top Priority

চরিত্র ও প্রেক্ষাপট: Two Friends — Smartphones for online research versus dangers of gaming addiction and eye strain.

পূর্ণাঙ্গ প্রমিত সংলাপ স্ক্রিপ্ট (Model Conversational Script):

Farhan: Assalamu Alaikum, Nayeem. I noticed you recently bought a new smartphone.

Nayeem: Wa Alaikum Assalam, Farhan. Yes, my father purchased it for my online classes and educational research.

Farhan: Modern mobile phones are truly marvelous technological inventions. What useful purposes do you use it for?

Nayeem: It acts like a portable computer. I can access dictionary apps, watch educational YouTube tutorials, read PDFs, and stay connected with teachers via study groups.

Farhan: It also enables instant communication with family members during emergencies from any corner of the globe.

Nayeem: However, I have noticed many of our classmates misusing their phones terribly.

Farhan: That is the dangerous abuse of technology. Excessive mobile gaming and social media scrolling consume valuable study hours and disrupt healthy sleep.

Nayeem: Furthermore, continuous screen exposure causes serious eye damage, finger joint strain, and mental anxiety.

Farhan: Some youngsters even fall victim to cybercrime, inappropriate content, and digital addiction.

Nayeem: Mobile phones are great servants, but terrible masters. Everything depends on how wisely we utilize them.

Farhan: True words. We must maintain strict digital discipline and limit our screen time to productive educational tasks only.

Nayeem: I completely agree with your wise advice, Farhan.

Dialogue 11: Bad Effects of Copying in the Examination

↑ ডায়ালগ সূচি

বোর্ড রেফারেন্স: Barishal Board '18; Sylhet Board '23 • High Priority

চরিত্র ও প্রেক্ষাপট: Two Friends — Unfair means in exams destroys creativity, integrity, and future national leadership.

পূর্ণাঙ্গ প্রমিত সংলাপ স্ক্রিপ্ট (Model Conversational Script):

Sabbir: Hello Tanvir, why do you look so disturbed today?

Tanvir: Hello Sabbir. During today's test, two students in our hall were expelled for copying from unauthorized notes.

Sabbir: It is deeply shameful. Copying in the examination has become an infectious moral disease among certain students.

Tanvir: Why do students resort to such shameful unfair means instead of studying honestly?

Sabbir: Mainly due to laziness, lack of consistent preparation throughout the year, and an unhealthy obsession with marks rather than real learning.

Tanvir: What disastrous consequences does copying bring upon a student's future?

Sabbir: An unfair certificate obtained by copying is completely worthless. Such a student possesses no genuine knowledge and fails miserably in job interviews and practical life.

Tanvir: Moreover, it destroys their personal integrity, self-respect, and moral character.

Sabbir: Exactly! A nation whose students cheat in exams can never produce competent doctors, honest engineers, or capable leaders.

Tanvir: What steps should be taken to eliminate copying entirely from our examination centers?

Sabbir: Exam halls must be monitored strictly with CCTV surveillance, invigilators must remain incorruptible, and strict legal penalties must be enforced.

Tanvir: Most importantly, students must be taught that an honest failure is a thousand times more honorable than a dishonest pass.

Sabbir: Brilliantly stated, Tanvir. Let us always uphold honesty in every exam we write.

Dialogue 12: Future Plan of Life after SSC / Dakhil Examination

↑ ডায়ালগ সূচি

বোর্ড রেফারেন্স: Dhaka Board '18; Rajshahi Board '20; Chattogram Board '24 • Top Priority

চরিত্র ও প্রেক্ষাপট: Two Classmates — Choosing science or humanities, pursuing higher secondary, and aiming for noble professions.

পূর্ণাঙ্গ প্রমিত সংলাপ স্ক্রিপ্ট (Model Conversational Script):

Asif: Hello Nabil, our SSC examination will be over next month. Have you thought about your future plan of life?

Nabil: Hello Asif! Yes, I have been contemplating my future goals very seriously.

Asif: What career path have you decided to pursue after completing school?

Nabil: I intend to get admitted into a reputed college in the Science group and eventually prepare for medical admission. My cherished dream is to become a doctor.

Asif: That is a remarkably noble profession! Why did you choose the medical profession specifically?

Nabil: Most of our rural villagers suffer terribly from lack of proper medical care and cannot afford costly private clinics in big cities. I want to establish a free clinic in my village and serve impoverished patients.

Asif: That reflects your deep patriotism and compassion, Nabil. What about you, Asif? What is your ambition?

Asif: My aim is to become an agricultural scientist. Bangladesh is an agrarian country, and developing climate-resilient crops is essential to ensure our national food security.

Nabil: That is an equally vital and patriotic goal! Both our ambitions are dedicated to the welfare of our country.

Asif: To achieve these dreams, we must first secure outstanding GPA 5.00 results in our SSC exams.

Nabil: Absolutely. Let us work with supreme dedication and turn our aspirations into reality.

Dialogue 13: Causes and Remedies of Road Accidents in Bangladesh

↑ ডায়ালগ সূচি

বোর্ড রেফারেন্স: Cumilla Board '19; Dinajpur Board '22; Jashore Board '24 • Top Priority

চরিত্র ও প্রেক্ষাপট: Bakul and Nayon — Reckless driving, unfit vehicles, lack of foot-overbridges, and strict enforcement of traffic laws.

পূর্ণাঙ্গ প্রমিত সংলাপ স্ক্রিপ্ট (Model Conversational Script):

Bakul: Hello Nayon, did you read today's newspaper?

Nayon: Hello Bakul. Yes, I was heartbroken to see reports of multiple fatal road accidents across the highway.

Bakul: It has become a horrific daily nightmare in our country. Why are road accidents increasing so rapidly?

Nayon: There are several major causes. Reckless driving, overspeeding, and dangerous overtaking by untrained drivers are primarily to blame.

Bakul: Moreover, many vehicles on our highways are completely unfit and lack proper braking systems.

Nayon: That's true. Jaywalking by pedestrians, violation of traffic signals, and narrow roads without dividers aggravate the crisis.

Bakul: The drivers often drive for long, exhausting hours without proper rest or sleep.

Nayon: What measures can be taken to remedy this terrible situation?

Bakul: First, traffic laws must be strictly enforced, and corrupt practices in issuing driving licenses must be eradicated immediately.

Nayon: Unfit and overloaded vehicles must be banned from all highways permanently.

Bakul: In addition, highways should be widened into four lanes with clear road dividers, and pedestrian foot-overbridges should be constructed.

Nayon: Public awareness through electronic media and school curriculum is also essential.

Bakul: If the government and citizens work together, we can make our roads safe for everyone.

Nayon: I completely agree with you. Thank you for this vital discussion, Bakul.

↑ উপরে ডায়ালগ সূচিতে ফিরুন

Dialogue 14: Importance of Physical Exercise for Good Health

↑ ডায়ালগ সূচি

বোর্ড রেফারেন্স: Chattogram Board '17; Barishal Board '22; Sylhet Board '24 • High Priority

চরিত্র ও প্রেক্ষাপট: Two Friends — Regular morning walk, gym, and outdoor sports for mental alertness and physical immunity.

পূর্ণাঙ্গ প্রমিত সংলাপ স্ক্রিপ্ট (Model Conversational Script):

Arman: Hello Joy, you look exceptionally energetic and refreshed this morning! What is the secret?

Joy: Hello Arman! The secret is very simple: I have made regular physical exercise an unbreakable part of my daily morning routine.

Arman: Do you exercise every single day? Isn't our busy study schedule exhausting enough?

Joy: On the contrary, physical exercise relieves study fatigue and recharges both body and mind.

Arman: In what ways does exercise benefit our health?

Joy: There is a famous proverb: 'A sound mind in a sound body.' Exercise improves blood circulation, strengthens our heart and muscles, and boosts our immune system against illnesses.

Arman: Does it also have a positive effect on academic performance?

Joy: Absolutely! Regular exercise stimulates brain cells, enhances concentration, improves memory retention, and relieves exam stress.

Arman: What kind of exercises do you practice?

Joy: I do twenty minutes of brisk jogging, light stretching, and play badminton or football in the afternoon.

Arman: I spend all my spare time sitting at my desk or looking at my mobile phone, which often leaves me feeling sluggish.

Joy: That sedentary lifestyle will ruin your health in the long run. Come join me for morning jogging tomorrow!

Arman: I definitely will! Thank you for motivating me toward a healthier life, Joy.

Dialogue 15: Merits and Demerits of Using the Internet

↑ ডায়ালগ সূচি

বোর্ড রেফারেন্স: Mymensingh Board '19; Rajshahi Board '23 • High Priority

চরিত্র ও প্রেক্ষাপট: Two Friends — Internet as a vast digital encyclopedia versus cyberbullying, screen addiction, and dark web.

পূর্ণাঙ্গ প্রমিত সংলাপ স্ক্রিপ্ট (Model Conversational Script):

Hasib: Assalamu Alaikum, Maruf. What are you browsing on your laptop?

Maruf: Wa Alaikum Assalam, Hasib. I am searching for academic reference articles on the internet for my science project.

Hasib: The internet is undoubtedly the greatest milestone of modern information technology.

Maruf: Indeed. It has transformed the entire world into a global village. Any information you desire is available at the click of a button.

Hasib: What do you consider the primary advantages of the internet for students?

Maruf: We can access world-class digital libraries, watch free university lectures, learn foreign languages, and communicate instantly across continents.

Hasib: E-commerce, online banking, and remote work opportunities have also made human life incredibly convenient.

Maruf: Yet, the internet has many dark and destructive aspects if not used cautiously.

Hasib: What demerits are you referring to?

Maruf: Wasting hours on addictive video games, exposure to cyberbullying, theft of private data by hackers, and the rapid spread of toxic fake news.

Hasib: Continuous internet browsing also isolates youth from real-life social relationships and physical outdoor activities.

Maruf: Therefore, self-control and cyber awareness are mandatory. We should harness the internet as a tool for intellectual growth rather than a source of moral decay.

Hasib: True wisdom, Maruf. Technology should serve human progress, not human destruction.

Dialogue 16: How to Open a Bank Account

↑ ডায়ালগ সূচি

বোর্ড রেফারেন্স: Dhaka Board '19; Dinajpur Board '23 • High Priority

চরিত্র ও প্রেক্ষাপট: Customer and Bank Manager — Account opening form, NID, nominee photo, utility bill, and initial minimum deposit.

পূর্ণাঙ্গ প্রমিত সংলাপ স্ক্রিপ্ট (Model Conversational Script):

Customer: Good morning, Sir. May I come in?

Bank Manager: Good morning! Please take a seat. How can I assist you today?

Customer: Thank you, Sir. I am an SSC student, and I wish to open a savings account with your bank to manage my scholarship money.

Bank Manager: That is a commendable initiative! Cultivating a savings habit at a young age is very wise. Opening a student savings account is quite simple.

Customer: What official documents will I need to submit with the application form?

Bank Manager: You will need two passport-sized photographs of yourself, a copy of your student ID card or birth registration certificate, and your school recommendation letter.

Customer: Do I also need to provide information about a nominee?

Bank Manager: Yes, certainly. You must designate a nominee—usually your father or mother—and submit one passport-sized photograph along with a copy of their National ID card.

Customer: What is the initial minimum deposit required to activate the account?

Bank Manager: For student accounts, the initial deposit is only five hundred Taka, and there are no hidden ledger maintenance fees.

Customer: Here is the filled application form along with all the required photocopies and photographs.

Bank Manager: Excellent. Everything is in order. Sign here at the bottom, please. Your account will be active by this afternoon, and we will issue your passbook and debit card.

Customer: Thank you very much for your kind cooperation, Sir!

Bank Manager: You are most welcome. Have a wonderful day!

Dialogue 17: Doctor and Patient on Sudden Fever and Joint Pain

↑ ডায়ালগ সূচি

বোর্ড রেফারেন্স: Jashore Board '19; Cumilla Board '23 • High Priority

চরিত্র ও প্রেক্ষাপট: Doctor and Patient — Patient describing high fever, shivering, and severe body ache; doctor suspecting viral flu/dengue.

পূর্ণাঙ্গ প্রমিত সংলাপ স্ক্রিপ্ট (Model Conversational Script):

Patient: Good evening, Doctor. May I come in?

Doctor: Good evening. Please have a seat. What seems to be the problem?

Patient: Doctor, I have been suffering from a sudden high fever and shivering since yesterday evening.

Doctor: Let me check your temperature and pulse. Yes, your temperature is 103 degrees Fahrenheit. Are you experiencing any other symptoms?

Patient: I have an excruciating headache behind my eyes and severe pain in all my joints and muscles. My entire body feels broken.

Doctor: These symptoms of high fever, retro-orbital eye pain, and acute joint aches strongly suggest viral dengue fever. Have you noticed any red rashes on your skin?

Patient: No rashes yet, but I feel mild nausea and extreme physical weakness.

Doctor: Do not worry, but we must act vigilantly. I am prescribing an immediate Complete Blood Count (CBC) and Dengue NS1 Antigen test to check your platelet count.

Patient: Is it dangerous, Doctor?

Doctor: If detected early and managed properly, it is not dangerous. For now, take Paracetamol for the fever. Never take Aspirin or painkiller tablets, as they cause internal bleeding.

Patient: What should my diet be during this illness?

Doctor: Drink plenty of oral saline, green coconut water, fresh fruit juices, and clear soup to stay thoroughly hydrated. Complete bed rest is mandatory.

Patient: Thank you, Doctor. I will get the blood tests done immediately and report back with the results.

↑ উপরে ডায়ালগ সূচিতে ফিরুন

Dialogue 18: Importance of Early Rising

↑ ডায়ালগ সূচি

বোর্ড রেফারেন্স: Barishal Board '17; Chattogram Board '23 • High Priority

চরিত্র ও প্রেক্ষাপট: Two Friends — Early morning fresh air, extra working hours, healthy habit, and sound mental peace.

পূর্ণাঙ্গ প্রমিত সংলাপ স্ক্রিপ্ট (Model Conversational Script):

Helal: Assalamu Alaikum, Belal. You are up very early today!

Belal: Wa Alaikum Assalam, Helal. I always wake up before dawn. Early rising is my daily habit.

Helal: I find it terribly difficult to leave my warm bed early in the morning. What makes early rising so valuable to you?

Belal: There is an ancient and timeless rhyme: 'Early to bed and early to rise makes a man healthy, wealthy, and wise.'

Helal: How does it improve physical health?

Belal: In the early morning, the air is clean, fresh, and free from vehicle smoke and dust. Breathing that pure oxygen revitalizes our lungs and blood.

Helal: Does an early riser also get more productive study time?

Belal: Absolutely! The early morning atmosphere is remarkably peaceful and quiet. Whatever we memorize at that time registers permanently in our memory.

Helal: Moreover, an early riser has plenty of time to organize his entire day without rushing in panic.

Belal: Exactly. A late riser, on the other hand, wakes up hurried, misses breakfast, runs late for school, and remains tired and disorganized all day long.

Helal: I realize now why I always felt rushed and stressed. From tonight, I will sleep early so that I can rise at dawn.

Belal: That is a wonderful decision, Helal. You will experience the transformative magic of early rising within a single week.

Dialogue 19: Proper Use of Time and Punctuality

↑ ডায়ালগ সূচি

বোর্ড রেফারেন্স: Sylhet Board '16; Dhaka Board '23 • High Priority

চরিত্র ও প্রেক্ষাপট: Two Students — Time and tide wait for none; creating a balanced daily study routine for academic success.

পূর্ণাঙ্গ প্রমিত সংলাপ স্ক্রিপ্ট (Model Conversational Script):

Riyad: Hello Fahim, why are you sitting here looking so gloomy?

Fahim: Hello Riyad. The terminal exam is only two weeks away, and half my syllabus remains unstudied. I don't know how I will cover everything!

Riyad: You spent the entire term postponing your studies, playing video games, and idling away your days. Now you are paying the price.

Fahim: I deeply regret my laziness now. I never realized how fast time slips away.

Riyad: Remember the ancient proverb: 'Time and tide wait for none.' You can recover lost wealth through hard work, but lost time is gone forever.

Fahim: What should I do now to rescue my results?

Riyad: Stop wasting even a single second from this very moment. Prepare a realistic, hourly study routine for the next two weeks.

Fahim: How should I allocate my daily hours?

Riyad: Dedicate six hours to deep, focused study in the morning and evening, one hour for light revision, seven hours for restful sleep, and eliminate social media completely.

Fahim: Do you think punctuality and disciplined time management can still save my grades?

Riyad: Punctuality is the backbone of all great achievements. If you adhere strictly to your routine without procrastination, you can still achieve a respectable score.

Fahim: Thank you for your wake-up call, Riyad. I will respect every minute of my time from today onwards.

Dialogue 20: Dangers of Environmental Pollution and Ways to Check It

↑ ডায়ালগ সূচি

বোর্ড রেফারেন্স: Rajshahi Board '19; Mymensingh Board '23 • High Priority

চরিত্র ও প্রেক্ষাপট: Two Friends — Air, water, and sound pollution; planting trees, reducing single-use plastic, and using solar energy.

পূর্ণাঙ্গ প্রমিত সংলাপ স্ক্রিপ্ট (Model Conversational Script):

Sajib: Hello Munir, look at the thick blanket of grey smog hanging over the city today. Breathing has become so uncomfortable!

Munir: Hello Sajib. It is the tragic outcome of unchecked environmental pollution. Our environment is in grave peril.

Sajib: What are the primary forms of environmental pollution choking our country?

Munir: Air pollution, water pollution, and sound pollution are the three deadly demons destroying public health.

Sajib: What is causing this catastrophic air pollution?

Munir: Black exhaust fumes from defective vehicles, unregulated brick kilns, industrial chimneys, and burning piles of municipal plastic waste.

Sajib: And our rivers and water bodies are being turned into toxic drains by industrial chemical dumping and untreated sewage.

Munir: Exactly! Millions of people suffer from asthma, lung cancer, waterborne diseases, and hearing loss as a direct result.

Sajib: What urgent measures must be undertaken to check this environmental catastrophe?

Munir: First, brick kilns must adopt green technology, polluting vehicles must be banned, and industrial effluent treatment plants (ETP) must be enforced strictly.

Sajib: We must also ban single-use polythene bags completely, switch to solar and renewable energy, and carry out massive nationwide tree plantation drives.

Munir: Every citizen must take personal responsibility. Protecting our environment is safeguarding the survival of our future generations.

Dialogue 21: Need for Female Education for National Development

↑ ডায়ালগ সূচি

বোর্ড রেফারেন্স: Cumilla Board '17; Jashore Board '25 • Top Priority

চরিত্র ও প্রেক্ষাপট: Two Friends — Napoleon's quote 'Give me an educated mother, I will give you an educated nation.'

পূর্ণাঙ্গ প্রমিত সংলাপ স্ক্রিপ্ট (Model Conversational Script):

Shuvo: Assalamu Alaikum, Mizan. What book are you reading?

Mizan: Wa Alaikum Assalam, Shuvo. I am reading a collection of essays on women's empowerment and national development.

Shuvo: That is a very timely topic. Why is female education considered so critical for a developing nation like Bangladesh?

Mizan: Half of our total population consists of women. How can a nation hope to march forward if half of its citizens remain uneducated and backward?

Shuvo: That is a profound point. A bird cannot fly properly with only one wing.

Mizan: Exactly. Napoleon Bonaparte famously said: 'Give me an educated mother, and I will give you an educated nation.'

Shuvo: How does educating women directly benefit the entire household?

Mizan: An educated mother manages her family's nutrition, healthcare, and budget far more intelligently. She takes active care of her children's schooling and character.

Shuvo: It also enables women to become financially independent and contribute directly to the national economy through employment and entrepreneurship.

Mizan: Yes, in education, healthcare, administration, and the garment industry, our educated women are performing with outstanding excellence.

Shuvo: Therefore, eradicating child marriage and ensuring free higher secondary education for all girls must remain our top national priority.

Mizan: Well spoken, Shuvo. Female education is not a privilege; it is the cornerstone of national progress.

Dialogue 22: Importance of Defeating Drug Addiction

↑ ডায়ালগ সূচি

বোর্ড রেফারেন্স: Chattogram Board '20; Dinajpur Board '24 • High Priority

চরিত্র ও প্রেক্ষাপট: Two Friends — Frustration among youth, destroying family peace, and the necessity of rehabilitation centers.

পূর্ণাঙ্গ প্রমিত সংলাপ স্ক্রিপ্ট (Model Conversational Script):

Tanvir: Hello Zubair, did you hear about the unfortunate youth from our neighborhood who was arrested yesterday?

Zubair: Hello Tanvir. Yes, it was heartbreaking to learn that he had become a helpless victim of drug addiction.

Tanvir: Drug addiction is a devastating curse that is silently ruining thousands of promising young lives across our society.

Zubair: Why do young people fall into the deadly trap of drugs like Yaba, heroin, and synthetic narcotics?

Tanvir: Often out of frustration, unemployment, broken family relationships, or dangerous peer pressure from bad companions.

Zubair: What terrible damage does drug addiction inflict on the human body and mind?

Tanvir: It completely destroys brain cells, causes kidney and liver failure, and leads to severe psychological disorders and depression.

Zubair: Not only that, an addict loses all moral judgment and often resorts to theft, robbery, and violence to pay for daily drugs, destroying family peace.

Tanvir: What comprehensive steps must be taken to defeat this deadly menace?

Zubair: The government must smash international drug trafficking cartels with an iron hand and enforce the death penalty for kingpins.

Tanvir: Furthermore, we need specialized, compassionate rehabilitation centers to treat addicted youth and reintegrate them into society.

Zubair: Families and community leaders must also provide emotional support to youth and promote healthy sports and cultural activities.

Tanvir: Let us unite our voices and declare: 'Say No to Drugs, and Yes to Life!'

Rimon: Hello Sadik, our final exams will conclude next week. How about planning an educational study tour with our classmates?

Sadik: Hello Rimon! That is a brilliant idea. We have worked hard all year, and a refreshing excursion will broaden our minds.

Rimon: Which historical location would you propose for our destination?

Sadik: I strongly propose visiting the historical city of Bagerhat. It is a UNESCO World Heritage site and rich in medieval Islamic architecture.

Rimon: That is an exceptional choice! We can explore the magnificent Sixty Dome Mosque (Shat Gombuj Masjid) and the shrine of Hazrat Khan Jahan Ali.

Dialogue 24: Food Adulteration: A Silent Killer

↑ ডায়ালগ সূচি

বোর্ড রেফারেন্স: Barishal Board '20; Rajshahi Board '25 • Top Priority

চরিত্র ও প্রেক্ষাপট: Two Citizens — Harmful formalin and carbide in fruits and fish, kidney and liver failure, mobile court vigilance.

পূর্ণাঙ্গ প্রমিত সংলাপ স্ক্রিপ্ট (Model Conversational Script):

First Citizen: Good morning, neighbor. What are you looking at so suspiciously in the market?

Second Citizen: Good morning. I am inspecting these apples and fish. I fear they have been treated with toxic formalin and chemicals.

First Citizen: Food adulteration has truly become an invisible, silent killer in our country.

Second Citizen: It is terrifying! Greedy, unscrupulous traders mix deadly carbide to ripen bananas and mangoes artificially, and spray toxic chemicals on fish and meat to keep them looking fresh.

First Citizen: Even milk, spices, mustard oil, and sweetmeats are adulterated with poisonous industrial dyes, brick dust, and urea.

Second Citizen: What catastrophic medical consequences are people suffering as a result?

First Citizen: Doctors report that the alarming surge in kidney failure, liver cirrhosis, stomach cancer, and heart disease across Bangladesh is directly linked to adulterated food.

Second Citizen: Pregnant women and innocent children are the most vulnerable victims of this heartless commercial greed.

First Citizen: What must the authorities do to eradicate this crime against humanity?

Second Citizen: Mobile courts must operate continuously throughout the year, conducting random laboratory tests in wholesale and retail bazaars.

First Citizen: Corrupt hoarders and adulterators must be sentenced to rigorous life imprisonment, and their businesses permanently confiscated.

Second Citizen: The public must also become vigilant, boycott suspicious markets, and support certified organic farming.

First Citizen: Human life is precious; no one should be allowed to poison our nation for temporary profit.

Dialogue 25: Price Hike of Daily Commodities and Sufferings of Poor

↑ ডায়ালগ সূচি

বোর্ড রেফারেন্স: Dinajpur Board '20; Mymensingh Board '25 • Top Priority

চরিত্র ও প্রেক্ষাপট: Two Customers at Market — Skyrocketing price of rice, oil, and vegetables; syndicate manipulation and TCB truck relief.

পূর্ণাঙ্গ প্রমিত সংলাপ স্ক্রিপ্ট (Model Conversational Script):

First Customer: Assalamu Alaikum, brother. Look at the price list in the grocery market today! It is shocking.

Second Customer: Wa Alaikum Assalam. It is completely unbearable! The prices of essential commodities like rice, lentils, edible oil, and vegetables are skyrocketing every single day.

First Customer: A poor laborer earning five hundred Taka a day cannot even afford basic rice and potatoes for his family.

Second Customer: How can low-income and fixed-salary families survive in the face of such relentless inflation?

First Customer: What is causing this unnatural, continuous price hike?

Second Customer: While global fuel prices and transport costs have contributed, the primary culprit is illegal market syndicates and artificial hoarding by greedy wholesalers.

First Customer: Exactly! Middlemen hoard essential food stocks in secret warehouses, create artificial shortages, and fleece helpless consumers.

Second Customer: Extortion along transport highways also inflates the cost of vegetables before they even reach city markets.

First Customer: What steps should the government take immediately to bring relief to the common people?

Second Customer: The Trading Corporation of Bangladesh (TCB) must expand open-market truck sales of subsidized food in every ward and village.

First Customer: Furthermore, consumer rights protection directorates must conduct strict daily raids to smash corrupt trading cartels and enforce fair retail prices.

Second Customer: If the syndicates are broken, prices will return to normal, and the poor can breathe a sigh of relief.

Dialogue 26: Impact of Climate Change and Global Warming on Bangladesh

↑ ডায়ালগ সূচি

বোর্ড রেফারেন্স: Jashore Board '20; Dhaka Board '26 • Top Priority

চরিত্র ও প্রেক্ষাপট: Two Students — Rising sea level, cyclone salinity in coastal belt, climate refugees, and COP summit goals.

পূর্ণাঙ্গ প্রমিত সংলাপ স্ক্রিপ্ট (Model Conversational Script):

Tahsin: Hello Siam, did you follow the proceedings of the recent United Nations Climate Change Conference?

Siam: Hello Tahsin. Yes, I followed the news closely. The reports on global warming and rising sea levels are deeply alarming for Bangladesh.

Tahsin: Our country contributes less than one percent of global carbon emissions, yet we are among the most severely affected victims of climate change.

Siam: That is the cruel injustice of global climate crisis. How is Bangladesh currently experiencing these impacts?

Tahsin: Rising sea levels are submerging low-lying coastal areas in Khulna, Satkhira, and Barishal, pushing saline water into freshwater agricultural lands and drinking wells.

Siam: Furthermore, the frequency and ferocity of devastating cyclones, river erosion, and flash floods have intensified dramatically.

Tahsin: Millions of coastal farmers and fishermen are losing their ancestral homesteads, becoming helpless climate refugees in city slums.

Siam: What must the international community do to fulfill their climate obligations?

Tahsin: Developed industrialized nations must drastically slash their carbon emissions and fulfill their promised billions in climate adaptation funds to vulnerable nations.

Siam: What domestic resilience measures should Bangladesh implement?

Tahsin: We must build stronger coastal embankments, preserve the mangrove barrier of the Sundarbans, and innovate saline-tolerant and flood-resistant rice varieties.

Siam: Protecting our planet is an urgent collective moral duty for all mankind.

Dialogue 28: Prevention of Dengue Fever (Model Solution 28)

↑ ডায়ালগ সূচি

বোর্ড রেফারেন্স: SSC Curriculum Model 28 • Top Priority (Full Model Solution Available)

চরিত্র ও প্রেক্ষাপট: Sajid and Father — Sajid asks his father about Aedes mosquitoes, stagnant water, break-bone fever, and clean balconies.

পূর্ণাঙ্গ প্রমিত সংলাপ স্ক্রিপ্ট (Model Conversational Script):

Sajid: Father, what is dengue fever, and why is everyone so worried about it?

Father: Dengue is a viral fever transmitted by the female Aedes mosquito. It causes high fever, severe headache, and vomiting.

Sajid: I also heard that people get a lot of pain in their joints.

Father: Yes, it is sometimes called "break-bone fever" because of that severe joint pain.

Sajid: How can we prevent these mosquitoes from growing?

Father: We must make sure there is no stagnant water around our house.

Sajid: Like in flower pots, discarded tyres, or empty tins?

Father: Exactly. They lay their eggs in clean, standing water.

Sajid: What should we do to protect ourselves at home?

Father: We should use mosquito nets while sleeping and wear long-sleeved clothes.

Sajid: Should we also use mosquito coils or sprays?

Father: Yes, but keeping our surroundings clean and dry is the best protection.

Sajid: I will check our balcony right now for any trapped water.

Father: Good job, Sajid. Public awareness is the first step to staying safe.

Dialogue 29: Merits and Demerits of Facebook (Model Solution 29)

পূর্ণাঙ্গ প্রমিত সংলাপ স্ক্রিপ্ট (Model Conversational Script):

Myself: Hello Amid, you look worried today. What happened to you?

Amid: Hello. Yes, I am really upset about my exam result.

Myself: I heard that your result was not good this time.

Amid: Yes, I got much lower marks than I expected.

Myself: Do you know why your result became so poor?

Amid: I think I wasted too much time on Facebook every day.

Myself: How many hours do you usually spend on Facebook?

Amid: Sometimes I spend five or six hours without noticing the time.

Myself: That is a very long time for a student like you.

Amid: I know that now, but I could not control myself before.

Myself: What do you usually do there for so long?

Amid: I chat with friends, watch videos, and read different posts.

Myself: Facebook has some useful sides if we use it properly.

Amid: Really? I always thought it was only for entertainment.

Myself: It helps us stay in touch with friends and relatives easily.

Amid: Yes, I can talk to my cousins who live far away.

Myself: It also helps people share news and educational resources very quickly.

Amid: That is true because I often get news there first.

Myself: Many students also use it for learning new things through study groups and pages.

Amid: I never used it for study before.

Myself: Some pages share lessons, notes, and educational videos.

Amid: That sounds very helpful for students like us.

Myself: But Facebook also has many harmful effects if overused.

Amid: Yes, I have already felt some of them firsthand.

Myself: It can waste valuable study time and disrupt sleep very easily.

Amid: That is exactly what happened in my life.

Myself: You should make a fixed schedule of no more than 30 minutes a day for it.

Amid: That is a very good idea.

Myself: You can use the rest of your time for study and physical exercise.

Amid: I will try my best to give more time to my studies.

Myself: Then I believe your result will definitely improve again.

Amid: Thank you for giving me such a wise suggestion, my friend.

Dialogue 32: The Bad Effects of Smoking (Model Solution 32)

↑ ডায়ালগ সূচি

বোর্ড রেফারেন্স: SSC Curriculum Model 32 • Top Priority (Full Model Solution Available)

চরিত্র ও প্রেক্ষাপট: Reza and Babu — Babu suffers from persistent cough due to chain smoking; Reza warns him of lung cancer and stroke.

পূর্ণাঙ্গ প্রমিত সংলাপ স্ক্রিপ্ট (Model Conversational Script):

Reza: Hello, Babu. How are you?

Babu: I am not well, Reza. I have been suffering from a continuous chest cough.

Reza: I have heard you have become a chain smoker recently. Smoking is definitely the root cause of your illness.

Babu: The doctor has also diagnosed the same thing.

Reza: Why don't you give up smoking immediately? Don't you know the fatal consequences of smoking?

Babu: I tried to quit several times, but I couldn't. I can't even concentrate on my studies without a cigarette.

Reza: If you had considered its deadly poisons seriously, you would never have touched another cigarette.

Babu: How much harm can smoking really cause?

Reza: Smoking causes severe diseases like lung cancer, heart attacks, stroke, chronic bronchitis, and asthma. Furthermore, nicotine damages your brain cells and burns away your hard-earned money.

Babu: Is there any beneficial side to smoking at all?

Reza: Of course not! Not a single medical scientist could ever put forward any argument in favor of smoking. It only invites premature death.

Babu: You have truly opened my eyes. I will give up smoking permanently from this very day.

Reza: Excellent decision, Babu! The sooner you quit, the healthier your life will be.

Babu: Thank you so much for your caring advice.

↑ উপরে ডায়ালগ সূচিতে ফিরুন

৭. সচরাচর জিজ্ঞাসা (FAQ)

Question 1: Completing Story-তে টাইটেল না দিলে কি নম্বর কাটা যায়?

উত্তর: হ্যাঁ, বোর্ড পরীক্ষার নির্দেশনা অনুযায়ী গল্পের একটি চমৎকার ও প্রাসঙ্গিক শিরোনামের জন্য আলাদা ২ নম্বর বরাদ্দ থাকে। তাই শিরোনাম কখনোই বাদ দেওয়া যাবে না।

Question 2: Dialogue Writing-এ কত জোড়া সংলাপ লেখা আদর্শ?

উত্তর: আদর্শ সংলাপে প্রতিটি চরিত্রের কমপক্ষে ৫ থেকে ৬টি করে অর্থপূর্ণ বক্তব্য অর্থাৎ মোট ১০ থেকে ১২টি সংলাপ টার্ন থাকা উচিত। খুব ছোট সংলাপে পুরো নম্বর পাওয়া কঠিন।

Question 3: প্রম্পটের বাক্যগুলো কি উত্তরপত্রে লিখতে হবে?

উত্তর: হ্যাঁ, প্রশ্নপত্রে যে প্রম্পট দেওয়া থাকে, সেই অংশটুকু উত্তরপত্রে প্রথমে তুলে তারপর গল্পের স্বাভাবিক সমাপ্তি পর্যন্ত নিজস্ব বাক্য যোগ করতে হবে।

Question 4: গল্প লেখার শেষে কি মোরাল (Moral) লেখা বাধ্যতামূলক?

উত্তর: যদিও বোর্ডে সরাসরি মোরাল লেখার বাধ্যতামূলক শর্ত থাকে না, তবে গল্পের শেষে এক লাইনে একটি মার্জিত নীতিকথা লিখে দিলে পরীক্ষক অত্যন্ত সন্তুষ্ট হন এবং সর্বোচ্চ ১৫ নম্বর পাওয়ার সম্ভাবনা নিশ্চিত হয়।

এসএসসি ২০২৭ ইংরেজি ১ম পত্র স্টাডি সিলো সিরিজ (SSC 2027 English Study Silo Series)

জাতীয় শিক্ষাক্রমের পূর্ণাঙ্গ সিলেবাস ও প্রশ্নভিত্তিক ধারাবাহিক প্রস্তুতি নির্দেশিকাসমূহ ক্রমানুসারে পড়ুন:

  • পিলার হাব: SSC English 1st Paper Suggestion 2027 (মাস্টার হাব ও মানবণ্টন)
  • Part 01: SSC 2027 English Seen Passage Suggestion (সিন প্যাসেজ MCQ ও প্রশ্নোত্তর)
  • Part 02: SSC 2027 English Unseen Passage & Summary Suggestion (আনসিন ও সামারি)
  • Part 03: SSC 2027 English Matching & Rearrange Suggestion (ম্যাচিং টেবিল ও রি-অ্যারেঞ্জ)
  • Part 04: SSC 2027 English Poems & Stories Suggestion (কবিতা ও গল্প প্রশ্নোত্তর)

item.title: SSC 2027 English Seen Passage Suggestion | এসএসসি সিন প্যাসেজ MCQ ও প্রশ্নোত্তর (100% Common)
item.dc:creator: ayesha
item.content:encoded:
টপিক ও ফোকাস: SSC 2027 English Seen Passage Suggestion (Questions 1, 2, 3)

মাধ্যমিক ও উচ্চমাধ্যমিক শিক্ষা বোর্ডের নতুন কারিকুলাম অনুসারে SSC 2027 English Seen Passage Suggestion পর্বে শিক্ষার্থীদের পাঠ্যবই English For Today (EFT) থেকে প্রথম তিনটি প্রশ্ন সমাধান করতে হয়। এই অংশে মোট ২২ নম্বর বরাদ্দ থাকে—যার মধ্যে Question 1: Multiple Choice Questions (MCQ - 7 Marks), Question 2: Open-Ended Question Answer (10 Marks) এবং Question 3: Gap Filling Without Clues (5 Marks) অন্তর্ভুক্ত। ঢাকা, চট্টগ্রাম, রাজশাহীসহ সকল শিক্ষা বোর্ডের বিগত ৫ বছরের বোর্ড প্রশ্ন বিশ্লেষণ করে এখানে পাঠ্যবইয়ের ৩৩টি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ সিন প্যাসেজের ৩-স্টার সুপার সাজেশন, জাম্প-লিংক মাস্টার সূচি, হুবহু বোর্ড প্রশ্নের মডেল টেস্ট এবং শতভাগ কমন পাওয়ার টেকনিক্যাল টিপস তুলে ধরা হলো।

বিষয়সূচি (Table of Contents)

  • ১. সিন প্যাসেজ: নম্বর বণ্টন ও প্রশ্নকাঠামো (Marks Distribution)
  • ২. পাঠ্যবইয়ের ৩৩টি সিন প্যাসেজ মাস্টার সূচি ও জাম্প আর্কিটেকচার (Master Index)
  • ৩. প্রশ্ন ১: MCQ সমাধানের ব্যাকরণ ও টেক্সচুয়াল কৌশল (Q1 Guide)
  • ৪. প্রশ্ন ২: Open-Ended প্রশ্নে পূর্ণ ১০/১০ পাওয়ার নিয়ম (Q2 Guide)
  • ৫. প্রশ্ন ৩: Gap Filling Without Clues সমাধানের ৫টি কৌশল (Q3 Guide)
  • ৬. ৩৩টি সিন প্যাসেজ: পূর্ণাঙ্গ টেক্সট, MCQ, প্রশ্নোত্তর ও গ্যাপ ফিলিং সমাধান (All 33 Solution Cards)
  • ৭. মডেল পরীক্ষা ০১: দাখিল ২০২৬ বোর্ড প্রশ্ন ও পূর্ণাঙ্গ সমাধান (Zahir Raihan)
  • ৮. মডেল পরীক্ষা ০২: এক্সক্লুসিভ মডেল টেস্ট ও পূর্ণাঙ্গ সমাধান (Climate Change)
  • ৯. সচরাচর জিজ্ঞাসা (FAQ)

১. সিন প্যাসেজ: নম্বর বণ্টন ও প্রশ্নকাঠামো (Marks Distribution)

এসএসসি ও দাখিল পরীক্ষায় প্রথম দুটি প্যাসেজ সরাসরি NCTB প্রণীত পাঠ্যবই English For Today থেকে নেওয়া হয়। ১ম প্যাসেজ থেকে প্রশ্ন ১ ও ২ এবং ২য় প্যাসেজ থেকে প্রশ্ন ৩ গঠিত হয়।

প্রশ্ন নম্বর প্রশ্নের ধরন (Question Type) উৎস (Source) নম্বর (Marks)
প্রশ্ন ১ (Q1) Multiple Choice Questions (MCQ) Seen Passage 1 (১ম সিন প্যাসেজ) 1 × 7 = 7 নম্বর
প্রশ্ন ২ (Q2) Answering Questions (Open-Ended) Seen Passage 1 (১ম সিন প্যাসেজ) 2 × 5 = 10 নম্বর
প্রশ্ন ৩ (Q3) Gap Filling Without Clues Seen Passage 2 (২য় সিন প্যাসেজ) 1 × 5 = 5 নম্বর
মোট নম্বর (Total Marks): ২২ নম্বর

২. পাঠ্যবইয়ের ৩৩টি সিন প্যাসেজ মাস্টার সূচি ও জাম্প আর্কিটেকচার (Master Index)

নিচে ২০২৭ সালের এসএসসি ও দাখিল পরীক্ষার্থীদের জন্য পাঠ্যবইয়ের ৩৩টি সিন প্যাসেজ গুরুত্ব অনুযায়ী ৩-স্টার (সর্বাধিক সম্ভাব্য), ২-স্টার ও ১-স্টার ক্যাটাগরিতে বোর্ড রেফারেন্সসহ সাজানো হলো। যেকোনো প্যাসেজের নামের ওপর অথবা ডানের সবুজ পিল বাটনে ক্লিক করে সরাসরি সংশ্লিষ্ট প্যাসেজের টেক্সট, MCQ, প্রশ্নোত্তর ও গ্যাপ ফিলিং অনুশীলনীতে চলে যান:

ক্র. স্টার প্যাসেজের শিরোনাম ও বিষয়বস্তু ইউনিট ও লেসন বিগত বোর্ড পরীক্ষা অনুশীলনী লিঙ্ক
01 *** Meherjan's Struggle with River Erosion (মেহেরজানের নদীভাঙন ও নিঃস্ব জীবন)
Climate Change, Jamuna River Erosion & Homeless Victims		 Unit-2, Lesson-1(A) Ctg.B., Dinj.B. '19, B.B. '22, J.B. '23, C.B., Syl.B., M.B. '26 অনুশীলন ও সমাধান দেখুন
02 * Environmental Pollution in Bangladesh: Industrial and Urban Threats
Environmental Pollution, Air, Water and Soil Contamination		 Unit-2, Lesson-2(B) J. B. '26 অনুশীলন ও সমাধান দেখুন
03 *** Humans and Global Climate: Greenhouse Gases and Deforestation
Climate Change, Human Impact & Greenhouse Gas Emissions		 Unit-2, Lesson-3(A) D. B., Ctg. B. '26 অনুশীলন ও সমাধান দেখুন
04 ** Let's Save Our Planet: Waste Management and the 3Rs Principle
Ecological Conservation, 3Rs (Reduce, Reuse, Recycle) & Waste Management		 Unit-2, Lesson-5(B) Syl.B. '22, R. B. '26 অনুশীলন ও সমাধান দেখুন
05 * Youth Pastimes: Shyam's Village Childhood and Rural Creativity
Youth Recreation, Rural Lifestyle & Artistic Expression		 Unit-3, Lesson-1(G) B. B. '26 অনুশীলন ও সমাধান দেখুন
06 ** Changing Childhood Pastimes: The Shift from Open Fields to Digital Screens
Generational Shift in Recreation, Urban Congestion & Screen Addiction		 Unit-3, Lesson-3(A) Dinj. B. '26 অনুশীলন ও সমাধান দেখুন
07 *** May Day: The Historic Struggle for an Eight-Hour Workday
Labour Rights, Chicago Haymarket Massacre (1886) & Working Hours		 Unit-4, Lesson-2(B) Dakhil Exam-2019; C.B. '24, D.B. '20, '22, '25, Dinj.B. '25 অনুশীলন ও সমাধান দেখুন
08 *** 21 February: National Mourning and the Genesis of Independence
Language Movement (1952), Salam-Barkat-Rafiq & Seeds of Independence		 Unit-4, Lesson-3(B) Dakhil Exam-2017; R.B. '23 অনুশীলন ও সমাধান দেখুন
09 ** International Mother Language Day: Global Recognition of Linguistic Diversity
UNESCO Proclamation (1999), Multilingualism & Cultural Heritage		 Unit-4, Lesson-4(B) Dakhil Exam-2022; C.B. '19 অনুশীলন ও সমাধান দেখুন
10 *** 26 March: Independence Day of Bangladesh and National Glory
Independence Day, 26 March, National Memorial at Savar & Statehood		 Unit-4, Lesson-5(B) J.B. '19, Syl.B. '19, '20; Dinj.B. '22, C.B. '23, D.B. '24 অনুশীলন ও সমাধান দেখুন
11 * Pahela Boishakh: The Celebration of Bengali New Year and Cultural Heritage
Bengali New Year, Mongol Shobhajatra, Chhayanaut & Secular Heritage		 Unit-4, Lesson-6(B) Dakhil Exam-2018, B.B. '23 অনুশীলন ও সমাধান দেখুন
12 * Good Citizens and Moral Awareness: The Foundations of a Civilized Society
Civic Duties, Moral Values & Responsibilities of a Good Citizen		 Unit-5, Lesson-1(B) Standard Textbook Review অনুশীলন ও সমাধান দেখুন
13 * Environmental Cleanliness: Waste Disposal and Civic Responsibility
Urban Cleanliness, Waste Segregation & Civic Consciousness		 Unit-5, Lesson-3(C) Standard Textbook Review অনুশীলন ও সমাধান দেখুন
14 * Youth Volunteering: Carmichael College Students Serving the Community
Community Service, Youth Leadership & Flood Relief Action		 Unit-5, Lesson-4(B) R.B. '22 অনুশীলন ও সমাধান দেখুন
15 ** Emerging Job Markets: Vocational Skills and Future Career Planning
Career Planning, Technical Skills & 21st-Century Job Market		 Unit-5, Lesson-5(D) C.B. '22 অনুশীলন ও সমাধান দেখুন
16 ** The Republic of Maldives: An Island Nation in the Indian Ocean
South Asian Geography, Coral Atolls & Natural Marine Beauty		 Unit-6, Lesson-3(B) Standard Board Review অনুশীলন ও সমাধান দেখুন
17 * The Maldives: The Looming Ecological Threat of Sea Level Rise
Climate Change, Sea Level Rise & Existential Threat to Low-Lying Islands		 Unit-6, Lesson-3(B) D.B. '19 অনুশীলন ও সমাধান দেখুন
18 * Bhutan: The Land of the Thunder Dragon and Gross National Happiness
South Asian Culture, Bhutan, Gross National Happiness & Environmental Forest Cover		 Unit-6, Lesson-5(A) Standard Board Review অনুশীলন ও সমাধান দেখুন
19 * Shilpacharya Zainul Abedin: The 1943 Famine Sketches and Cultural Renaissance
Modern Art, Famine Sketches of 1943 & Folk Art Museum in Sonargaon		 Unit-7, Lesson-1(B) Standard Board Review অনুশীলন ও সমাধান দেখুন
20 ** Traditional Handloom and Nakshi Kantha: The Folk Embroidery of Bengal
Traditional Crafts, Nakshi Kantha Embroidery & Rural Women's Art		 Unit-7, Lesson-2(B) Standard Board Review অনুশীলন ও সমাধান দেখুন
21 ** Zahir Raihan: Visionary Filmmaker, Language Activist and Liberation Martyr
Cinema as Resistance, Language Movement & Liberation War Martyrdom		 Unit-7, Lesson-3(B) Ctg. B. '24 অনুশীলন ও সমাধান দেখুন
22 ** Mother Teresa: Apostle of the Dying Destitute and Angel of Mercy
Selfless Philanthropy, Nirmal Hriday & Nobel Peace Prize (1979)		 Unit-7, Lesson-5(A) R.B. '20, M.B. '22, Ctg.B. '23 অনুশীলন ও সমাধান দেখুন
23 * Steve Jobs: Digital Pioneer and Co-Founder of the Personal Computer Era
Technological Innovation, Apple Inc., iPhone & Creative Design		 Unit-7, Lesson-6(B) Standard Board Review অনুশীলন ও সমাধান দেখুন
24 *** Shat Gombuj Mosque in Bagerhat: The Architectural Grandeur of Khan Jahan Ali

৩. প্রশ্ন ১: MCQ সমাধানের ব্যাকরণ ও টেক্সচুয়াল কৌশল (Q1 Guide)

Q1-এ ৭টি বহুনির্বাচনী প্রশ্ন থাকে। প্রতিটি প্রশ্নে সঠিক উত্তরের জন্য ১ নম্বর বরাদ্দ। MCQ-তে পূর্ণ ৭ নম্বর পাওয়ার মূল কৌশলগুলো হলো:

  • Contextual Synonym ও Antonym: শব্দার্থ সরাসরি আভিধানিক না হয়ে অনেক সময় প্যাসেজের ভাবার্থ অনুযায়ী হয়। বাক্যটির পুরো অর্থ পড়ে উত্তরের অপশন নির্বাচন করুন।
  • Elimination Method: চারটি অপশনের মধ্যে যেসব অপশন নিশ্চিতভাবে ভুল বা প্যাসেজের তথ্যের সাথে সাংঘর্ষিক, সেগুলো আগে বাদ দিন।
  • Part of Speech রূপান্তর: প্রশ্নে যে Part of Speech-এ জানতে চাওয়া হয়েছে, সঠিক উত্তরও সেই একই ব্যাকরণিক ক্যাটাগরির হবে।

৪. প্রশ্ন ২: Open-Ended প্রশ্নে পূর্ণ ১০/১০ পাওয়ার নিয়ম (Q2 Guide)

Q2-এ ৫টি প্রশ্নের উত্তর লিখতে হয় (প্রতিটিতে ২ নম্বর)। পূর্ণ নম্বর পেতে নিচের নিয়মগুলো কঠোরভাবে মেনে চলুন:

  • হুবহু প্যাসেজ কপি না করা: প্যাসেজের বাক্য সরাসরি তুলে দিলে পরীক্ষক নম্বর কমিয়ে দেন। তথ্য প্যাসেজ থেকে নিয়ে নিজের ভাষায় বাক্য গঠন করুন।
  • Tense সঙ্গতি বজায় রাখা: প্রশ্ন যে Tense-এ থাকবে (Present/Past), উত্তরও ঠিক সেই Tense-এ লিখতে হবে। যেমন: প্রশ্ন "Why did he go?" হলে উত্তর "He went because..." দিয়ে শুরু হবে।
  • Two-part Structure: প্রতিটি ২ নম্বরের উত্তরে মূল উত্তরের সাথে ১টি প্রাসঙ্গিক সহায়ক বাক্য যুক্ত করলে পূর্ণ ২ নম্বর নিশ্চিত হয়।

৫. প্রশ্ন ৩: Gap Filling Without Clues সমাধানের ৫টি কৌশল (Q3 Guide)

২য় সিন প্যাসেজ থেকে এই ৫ নম্বরের শূন্যস্থান পূরণ আসে। কোনো অপশন বা বক্স দেওয়া থাকে না। এটি সমাধানের নিয়ম:

  • প্যাসেজ ২ মনোযোগ দিয়ে পড়ে শূন্যস্থানযুক্ত বাক্যটির সাথে প্যাসেজের মূল বাক্যের অর্থ মেলান।
  • শূন্যস্থানে Noun, Adjective, Verb না Adverb বসবে—তা ব্যাকরণিক নিয়মে চিহ্নিত করুন। Preposition-এর পর Noun/Gerund এবং Be-verb-এর পর Adjective বা Past Participle বসে।
  • একই শূন্যস্থানে একাধিক প্রাসঙ্গিক সমার্থক শব্দ গ্রহণযোগ্য, তবে বানান শতভাগ নির্ভুল হতে হবে।

নিচে ৩৩টি সিন প্যাসেজের প্রতিটি অধ্যায়ের পাঠ্যবইয়ের নির্বাচিত অনুচ্ছেদ, প্রশ্ন ১-এর মডেল MCQ, প্রশ্ন ২-এর অ্যানালিটিক্যাল প্রশ্নোত্তর এবং প্রশ্ন ৩-এর গ্যাপ ফিলিং মডেল এক্সারসাইজ ও সঠিক উত্তর দেওয়া হলো। প্রতিটি কার্ডের উপরে ও নিচে সিন প্যাসেজ সূচিতে ফিরে যাওয়ার বাটন সংযুক্ত রয়েছে:

Seen Passage 01: Meherjan's Struggle with River Erosion (মেহেরজানের নদীভাঙন ও নিঃস্ব জীবন)

↑ সিন প্যাসেজ সূচি

ইউনিট ও লেসন: Unit-2, Lesson-1(A) • বিষয়বস্তু: Climate Change, Jamuna River Erosion & Homeless Victims • রেটিং: *** • Top Priority (Most Probable) • বোর্ড: Ctg.B., Dinj.B. '19, B.B. '22, J.B. '23, C.B., Syl.B., M.B. '26

সিন প্যাসেজ মূল অনুচ্ছেদ (EFT Text Excerpt):

"Meherjan lives in a slum on the Sirajganj Town Protection Embankment. Her polythene-roofed shelter looks like a cage. She is nearly 45, but looks more than her age. In front of her shelter, she is trying to make a fire to cook the day's only meal. Her weak hands tremble as she adds some fallen leaves and straw to the fire. The whispering wind from the river Jamuna makes the fire unsteady. The dancing flames remind Meherjan of the turmoil in her life. Not long ago Meherjan had everything—a family, cultivable land and cattle. The erosion of the Jamuna gradually consumed all her landed property. It finally claimed her only shelter during the last monsoon. Now, she is only one of the estimated one lakh people who become homeless in Bangladesh every year due to river erosion."

Question 1: Choose the correct answer from the following alternatives (MCQ - 3 Model Questions)

(i) What does the phrase 'dancing flames' symbolize in the passage?

(a) A joyful festival (b) Instability and turmoil in Meherjan's life (c) Cold winter wind (d) A burning forest

সঠিক উত্তর: Instability and turmoil in Meherjan's life

(ii) How does river erosion affect the population of Bangladesh annually?

(a) It enriches farmers (b) It makes nearly one lakh people homeless (c) It prevents floods (d) It stops monsoon rains

সঠিক উত্তর: It makes nearly one lakh people homeless

(iii) The word 'consume' in the passage is closest in meaning to —

(a) Preserve (b) Devour or destroy (c) Construct (d) Purchase

সঠিক উত্তর: Devour or destroy

Question 2: Answer the following questions based on the passage (Open-Ended - 2 Questions)

(a) What did Meherjan lose to the fierce erosion of the river Jamuna?

উত্তর: Meherjan lost her family, cultivable land, cattle, and her last remaining homestead shelter to the relentless erosion of the river Jamuna, reducing her to an impoverished slum dweller.

(b) Why does Meherjan look much older than her actual age?

উত্তর: Meherjan looks much older than her forty-five years because of prolonged poverty, malnutrition, the physical exhaustion of displacement, and the severe emotional trauma of losing everything.

Question 3: Fill in each gap with a suitable word based on the passage (Gap Filling Without Clues - 5 Marks)

River erosion is one of the most devastating (a) ______ in Bangladesh. Every monsoon, mighty rivers like the Jamuna (b) ______ vast tracts of cultivable land and homesteads. As a result, countless families like Meherjan's are rendered completely (c) ______ and forced to take shelter in urban (d) ______. Proper embankment construction and climate adaptation are urgently needed to (e) ______ their suffering.

সঠিক উত্তর (Answer Key): (a) calamities / disasters  |  (b) erode / devour  |  (c) homeless / destitute  |  (d) slums / shanties  |  (e) mitigate / lessen

গুরুত্বপূর্ণ শব্দার্থ ও সমার্থক শব্দ (Key Vocabulary & Synonyms): Turmoil -> Agitation/chaos; Embankment -> Protective dike; Destitute -> Impoverished.

Seen Passage 02: Environmental Pollution in Bangladesh: Industrial and Urban Threats

↑ সিন প্যাসেজ সূচি

ইউনিট ও লেসন: Unit-2, Lesson-2(B) • বিষয়বস্তু: Environmental Pollution, Air, Water and Soil Contamination • রেটিং: * • Moderate • বোর্ড: J. B. '26

সিন প্যাসেজ মূল অনুচ্ছেদ (EFT Text Excerpt):

"Bangladesh is now in the grip of all sorts of environmental pollution—air pollution, water pollution, and soil pollution. The dwellers of urban areas are the worst sufferers of such pollution. Indiscriminate industrialization, rapid urbanization, and motorized transport are primarily responsible for contaminating the environment. Brick kilns and old vehicles emit toxic black smoke loaded with carbon monoxide and sulfur dioxide, severely degrading air quality in major cities like Dhaka. Simultaneously, industrial untreated effluents and household refuse are dumped into rivers like the Buriganga, rendering water biologically dead. Furthermore, excessive chemical fertilizers and non-biodegradable plastics degrade the fertility of topsoil."

Question 1: Choose the correct answer from the following alternatives (MCQ - 3 Model Questions)

(i) Which group of people suffers most severely from environmental pollution?

(a) Rural farmers (b) Inhabitants of urban areas (c) Coastal fishermen (d) Forest inhabitants

সঠিক উত্তর: Inhabitants of urban areas

(ii) What makes the water of the Buriganga biologically dead?

(a) Natural floodwater (b) Untreated industrial waste and sewage (c) Excessive fish breeding (d) Rainwater

সঠিক উত্তর: Untreated industrial waste and sewage

(iii) The word 'indiscriminate' means —

(a) Planned (b) Random and unselective (c) Careful (d) Legal

সঠিক উত্তর: Random and unselective

Question 2: Answer the following questions based on the passage (Open-Ended - 2 Questions)

(a) What are the primary sources of air pollution in metropolitan cities like Dhaka?

উত্তর: The primary sources of air pollution are emissions from outdated motorized vehicles, smoke from illegal brick kilns, dust from unregulated construction, and toxic emissions from urban industrial plants.

(b) How does soil pollution occur in Bangladesh?

উত্তর: Soil pollution occurs through the excessive application of synthetic chemical fertilizers and pesticides in farming, alongside the reckless dumping of non-biodegradable polythene bags and industrial solid waste.

Question 3: Fill in each gap with a suitable word based on the passage (Gap Filling Without Clues - 5 Marks)

Environmental pollution has reached an alarming (a) ______ in Bangladesh. Urban dwellers face severe health (b) ______ due to contaminated air and poisoned rivers. If strict environmental regulations and afforestation are not (c) ______ immediately, future generations will face catastrophic ecological (d) ______. Every citizen must raise (e) ______ to protect our ecosystem.

সঠিক উত্তর (Answer Key): (a) level / stage  |  (b) risks / hazards  |  (c) enforced / implemented  |  (d) disasters / crises  |  (e) awareness / consciousness

গুরুত্বপূর্ণ শব্দার্থ ও সমার্থক শব্দ (Key Vocabulary & Synonyms): Effluents -> Industrial liquid waste; Degrade -> Deteriorate; Inhabitants -> Residents.

Seen Passage 03: Humans and Global Climate: Greenhouse Gases and Deforestation

↑ সিন প্যাসেজ সূচি

ইউনিট ও লেসন: Unit-2, Lesson-3(A) • বিষয়বস্তু: Climate Change, Human Impact & Greenhouse Gas Emissions • রেটিং: *** • Top Priority (Most Probable) • বোর্ড: D. B., Ctg. B. '26

সিন প্যাসেজ মূল অনুচ্ছেদ (EFT Text Excerpt):

"Humans can neither change the sun's radiation nor the earth's orbit around the sun. But they can control the increase in the amount of greenhouse gases and its effect on the atmosphere. Only during the last hundred years, the concentration of carbon dioxide has risen alarmingly due to the reckless combustion of coal, oil, and natural gas in power plants and factories. Furthermore, humans are destroying millions of hectares of tropical forests every year to create farmland and procure timber. Trees naturally absorb vast quantities of carbon dioxide through photosynthesis; when forests are cleared and burnt, stored carbon is released back into the air. This atmospheric blanket traps heat, driving catastrophic global warming."

Question 1: Choose the correct answer from the following alternatives (MCQ - 3 Model Questions)

(i) What can humans actively control regarding global climate change?

(a) Earth's orbital path (b) The sun's solar radiation (c) Greenhouse gas emissions and deforestation (d) Oceanic tides

সঠিক উত্তর: Greenhouse gas emissions and deforestation

(ii) Why does deforestation accelerate global warming?

(a) Trees produce carbon dioxide (b) Forests absorb less sunlight (c) Felled trees can no longer absorb CO2 and release stored carbon (d) Trees cause excessive rainfall

সঠিক উত্তর: Felled trees can no longer absorb CO2 and release stored carbon

(iii) The term 'combustion' refers to —

(a) Cooling (b) Burning or chemical oxidation (c) Planting (d) Recycling

সঠিক উত্তর: Burning or chemical oxidation

Question 2: Answer the following questions based on the passage (Open-Ended - 2 Questions)

(a) How does industrial fossil fuel consumption enhance the greenhouse effect?

উত্তর: Industrial combustion of coal, gas, and oil releases massive volumes of carbon dioxide and other heat-trapping gases into the atmosphere, creating a thick heat-retaining blanket that prevents thermal radiation from escaping into space.

(b) What critical role do forests play in maintaining atmospheric balance?

উত্তর: Forests serve as vital carbon sinks by absorbing atmospheric carbon dioxide during photosynthesis and releasing life-sustaining oxygen, thereby naturally regulating global temperatures.

Question 3: Fill in each gap with a suitable word based on the passage (Gap Filling Without Clues - 5 Marks)

Global warming is largely the result of human (a) ______ on earth. By burning fossil fuels and felling trees (b) ______, humans have upset the delicate atmospheric balance. If we desire to protect our planet, we must reduce greenhouse gas (c) ______ and adopt clean (d) ______ sources. Preserving forests is also (e) ______ for climate stabilization.

সঠিক উত্তর (Answer Key): (a) activities / interference  |  (b) indiscriminately / recklessly  |  (c) emissions / discharge  |  (d) renewable / green  |  (e) vital / essential

গুরুত্বপূর্ণ শব্দার্থ ও সমার্থক শব্দ (Key Vocabulary & Synonyms): Combustion -> Burning; Photosynthesis -> Plant food synthesis; Radiation -> Energy emission.

Seen Passage 04: Let's Save Our Planet: Waste Management and the 3Rs Principle

↑ সিন প্যাসেজ সূচি

ইউনিট ও লেসন: Unit-2, Lesson-5(B) • বিষয়বস্তু: Ecological Conservation, 3Rs (Reduce, Reuse, Recycle) & Waste Management • রেটিং: ** • High Priority • বোর্ড: Syl.B. '22, R. B. '26

সিন প্যাসেজ মূল অনুচ্ছেদ (EFT Text Excerpt):

"LET'S SAVE OUR PLANET! Everyone produces waste daily, but how we manage that waste determines the future of our biosphere. To conserve the earth's dwindling natural resources and prevent landfill overflow, we must rigorously adopt the '3Rs' principle—Reduce, Reuse, and Recycle. 'Reduce' means cutting down on personal consumption and using fewer disposable products. 'Reuse' involves utilizing items repeatedly instead of discarding them after a single use, such as refilling glass bottles or donating clothing. 'Recycle' transforms discarded materials like paper, metal cans, and glass into valuable new products, substantially saving energy and reducing raw material extraction. Small household habits can create a profound global difference."

Question 1: Choose the correct answer from the following alternatives (MCQ - 3 Model Questions)

(i) What do the '3Rs' represent in modern environmental conservation?

(a) Read, Revise, Repeat (b) Reduce, Reuse, Recycle (c) Refuse, Restore, Rebuild (d) Reform, Regenerate, Renew

সঠিক উত্তর: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle

(ii) How does recycling save natural resources?

(a) By discarding more waste (b) By manufacturing new items from waste materials without extracting virgin resources (c) By burning plastic (d) By polluting rivers

সঠিক উত্তর: By manufacturing new items from waste materials without extracting virgin resources

(iii) The word 'dwindling' is synonymous with —

(a) Expanding (b) Diminishing or decreasing (c) Permanent (d) Abundant

সঠিক উত্তর: Diminishing or decreasing

Question 2: Answer the following questions based on the passage (Open-Ended - 2 Questions)

(a) What is the difference between 'reusing' and 'recycling'?

উত্তর: 'Reusing' means using an item again in its original form for the same or a different purpose, whereas 'recycling' involves reprocessing waste material chemically or industrially to manufacture entirely new products.

(b) How can ordinary citizens contribute to reducing household waste?

উত্তর: Citizens can minimize waste by choosing durable goods over disposable ones, carrying reusable cloth bags, avoiding unnecessary packaging, and conserving electricity and water in daily life.

Question 3: Fill in each gap with a suitable word based on the passage (Gap Filling Without Clues - 5 Marks)

Effective waste management is vital to preserve our fragile (a) ______. Practicing the 3Rs helps reduce the volume of garbage dumped into (b) ______. By reusing durable containers and recycling metals, we conserve energy and raw (c) ______. Therefore, environmental education must be (d) ______ in every school to build a sustainable (e) ______.

সঠিক উত্তর (Answer Key): (a) ecosystem / planet  |  (b) landfills / dumpsites  |  (c) materials / resources  |  (d) promoted / taught  |  (e) future / world

গুরুত্বপূর্ণ শব্দার্থ ও সমার্থক শব্দ (Key Vocabulary & Synonyms): Biosphere -> Earth's living zone; Diminishing -> Dwindling; Virgin resources -> Untouched raw materials.

সিন প্যাসেজ মূল অনুচ্ছেদ (EFT Text Excerpt):

"Hi, I'm Shyam. I'm from Magura, a scenic district in southwestern Bangladesh. While many urban teenagers spend their leisure glued to smartphone screens and online video games, my favourite pastimes are deeply rooted in rural nature. ৭. মডেল পরীক্ষা ০১: দাখিল ২০২৬ বোর্ড প্রশ্ন ও পূর্ণাঙ্গ সমাধান (Zahir Raihan)

"Zahir Raihan was one of the most talented film makers in Bangladesh. He was born on 19 August 1935 in the village Majupur in Feni district. He was an active worker of the Language Movement. He was one of the ten students to go out in a procession on 21 February 1952 despite a ban on such activities imposed by the authorities. As a result, he and many others were arrested and taken to prison. Raihan was also present at the historical meeting of Amtala on 21 February 1952. He also took part in the mass movement in 1969. In 1971, he joined the Liberation War. All through his life, Zahir Raihan dreamt for a democratic society, a society that would ensure freedom of speech. He had many dreams about our film industry too. He made a legendary film "Jibon Theke Neya" based on the Language Movement of 1952. It was a protest against the autocratic government then ruling our country. The family portrayed in that film symbolically represented East Pakistan. The family was ruled by an autocrat who had to go to prison for her conspiracy. During the Liberation War in 1971, this film was shown outside Bangladesh. Celebrated film makers like Satyajit Ray, Mrinal Sen, and Ritwik Ghatak appreciated the film. Raihan gave all the money the film made to the Freedom Fighters' trust. Besides, his great documentary on Pakistani atrocities, "Stop Genocide", helped create world sentiment in favour of our Liberation War. On 30 December 1971, someone informed Raihan about an address somewhere at Mirpur where he might find his brother, the famous writer Shahidullah Kaiser, who had gone missing from 14 December 1971. Kaiser was captured and killed by the Pakistani army and the local collaborators during the last days of the war. Accordingly, Raihan left home to get his brother back but he never returned. Zahir Raihan's dream was fulfilled. But it's a pity that this dreamer could not live to see his dream come true."

Question 2: Answering Questions (10 Marks)

(a) What do you know about Zahir Raihan?

উত্তর: Zahir Raihan was one of the most talented filmmakers, writers, and cultural activists of Bangladesh. Born on 19 August 1935 in Feni, he actively participated in the Language Movement of 1952, the 1969 mass uprising, and the 1971 Liberation War through his visionary cinema.

(b) Why was he arrested?

উত্তর: He was arrested because on 21 February 1952, he was among the brave group of ten students who defied Section 144 and led a procession demanding state language status for Bengali.

(c) When did he take part in the mass movement?

উত্তর: Zahir Raihan took an active part in the historic mass movement against the Pakistani autocracy in 1969.

(d) What is "Jibon Theke Neya"?

উত্তর: "Jibon Theke Neya" is a legendary political satirical film directed by Zahir Raihan based on the 1952 Language Movement. Through an autocratic family household, it symbolically portrayed the totalitarian Pakistani regime and East Pakistan's struggle for liberation.

(e) Why is Zahir Raihan considered a freedom fighter though he was a film maker?

উত্তর: Zahir Raihan is considered a freedom fighter because he contributed directly to the Liberation War by donating all proceeds from 'Jibon Theke Neya' to the Freedom Fighters' Trust and making the world-renowned documentary 'Stop Genocide' to rally global support against Pakistani atrocities.

Question 3: Gap Filling Without Clues (5 Marks)

Zahir Raihan was an active (a) [......] of the Language Movement. He (b) [......] in the mass movement and also joined in the Liberation War. He desired a democratic society that will (c) [......] freedom of speech. He worked to organise world (d) [......] by his great documentary 'Stop Genocide'. He (e) [......] his life for the freedom of the country.

সঠিক উত্তর: (a) worker / activist / participant (b) participated / took part (c) ensure / guarantee (d) sentiment / opinion / support (e) sacrificed / gave / dedicated

৮. মডেল পরীক্ষা ০২: এক্সক্লুসিভ মডেল টেস্ট ও পূর্ণাঙ্গ সমাধান (Climate Change)

"Humans can neither change the sun's radiation nor the earth's orbit around the sun. But they can control the increase in the amount of greenhouse gases and its effect on the atmosphere. Only during the last hundred years the carbon dioxide concentration has been raised alarmingly in the atmosphere and we humans can be held responsible for this. The main cause of the increase in carbon dioxide level in the atmosphere is the burning of fossil fuels. Since the end of the 19th century, industrial activities increased rapidly giving rise to many factories. These factories required energy, which was produced through the combustion of coal. Besides coal, other sources of energy such as mineral oil and natural gas were also burned to heat our houses, run cars and airplanes or to produce electricity. Nowadays, about 85 million barrels of crude oil are burned daily. Every time a fossil raw material is burned, it releases carbon dioxide into the air. Therefore, it is clear that more and more greenhouse gases like carbon dioxide are being generated worldwide by humans. Moreover, we are also strengthening the greenhouse effect by deforestation, which means cutting down trees. Trees that are burned up release large volumes of carbon dioxide gas into the air. On the other hand, as forests absorb a lot of carbon dioxide from the air and deliver oxygen instead, we also destroy an important storehouse of carbon dioxide when we clear forests."

Question 1: Multiple Choice Questions (7 Marks)

(a) What has alarmingly increased in the atmosphere over the last hundred years?

(i) Oxygen (ii) Carbon dioxide (iii) Nitrogen (iv) Hydrogen

সঠিক উত্তর: (ii) Carbon dioxide

(b) What is the main source of carbon dioxide emission?

(i) Solar energy (ii) Burning of fossil fuels (iii) Wind power (iv) Hydropower

সঠিক উত্তর: (ii) Burning of fossil fuels

(c) What is another major greenhouse gas besides carbon dioxide?

(i) Nitrogen (ii) Methane (iii) Argon (iv) Oxygen

সঠিক উত্তর: (ii) Methane

(d) How many barrels of crude oil are burned every day?

(i) 85,000 (ii) 850,000 (iii) 85 million (iv) 8.5 billion

সঠিক উত্তর: (iii) 85 million

(e) Why are greenhouse gases harmful?

(i) They increase oxygen levels. (ii) They trap heat. (iii) They cool the Earth. (iv) They absorb sunlight.

সঠিক উত্তর: (ii) They trap heat.

(f) What does "storehouse of carbon dioxide" refer to?

(i) Atmosphere (ii) Oceans (iii) Forests (iv) Fossil fuels

সঠিক উত্তর: (iii) Forests

(g) What term refers to the energy source used by factories?

(i) Renewable energy (ii) Fossil fuels (iii) Nuclear energy (iv) Solar energy

সঠিক উত্তর: (ii) Fossil fuels

Question 2: Answering Questions (10 Marks)

(a) What are the two major activities responsible for releasing carbon dioxide into the atmosphere?

উত্তর: The two major human activities responsible for emitting carbon dioxide are the combustion of fossil fuels (coal, crude oil, natural gas) in industries/vehicles, and widespread deforestation.

(b) What is the relationship between trees and carbon dioxide?

উত্তর: Trees act as a natural storehouse for carbon by absorbing carbon dioxide from the air and replenishing it with oxygen through photosynthesis. Burning or clearing trees releases that stored carbon back into the atmosphere.

(c) How does the burning of fossil fuels affect the earth's atmosphere?

উত্তর: Burning fossil fuels releases massive amounts of carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases into the atmosphere, which trap heat and cause global warming and unpredictable climate changes.

(d) What steps can humans take to control greenhouse gas emissions?

উত্তর: Humans can transition to renewable energy sources (solar, wind, hydroelectric), adopt energy-efficient technology, reduce reliance on crude oil and coal, stop deforestation, and initiate massive afforestation campaigns.

(e) Why do industrial activities rely heavily on coal and crude oil?

উত্তর: Since the end of the 19th century, industrial activities expanded rapidly and relied on coal and crude oil because they provided readily available, concentrated energy required to power machinery, heat factories, and generate electricity.

Question 3: Gap Filling Without Clues (5 Marks)

Fossil fuels are burned at an alarming rate due to (a) [......]. Coal is one of the fuels used for (b) [......] energy. Our atmosphere is being polluted for the (c) [......] of greenhouse gases day by day. Our (d) [......] on fossil fuels should be reduced. We should not destroy our (e) [......] which play a vital role to produce oxygen.

সঠিক উত্তর: (a) industrialization / rapid industrial growth (b) generating / producing (c) emission / concentration / increase (d) dependence / reliance (e) forests / trees

৯. সচরাচর জিজ্ঞাসা (FAQ)

প্রশ্ন ১: এসএসসি ২০২৭ ইংরেজি ১ম পত্রে সিন প্যাসেজে কত নম্বর বরাদ্দ থাকে?

উত্তর: সিন প্যাসেজ থেকে মোট ২২ নম্বর বরাদ্দ থাকে—প্রশ্ন ১ (MCQ - ৭ নম্বর), প্রশ্ন ২ (Open-Ended প্রশ্নোত্তর - ১০ নম্বর) এবং প্রশ্ন ৩ (Gap Filling Without Clues - ৫ নম্বর)।

প্রশ্ন ২: সিন প্যাসেজ থেকে কি হুবহু লাইন তুলে উত্তর দেওয়া যাবে?

উত্তর: না, হুবহু লাইন তুলে দিলে পরীক্ষক নম্বর কমিয়ে দেন। প্যাসেজ থেকে মূল তথ্য সংগ্রহ করে নিজের ভাষায় বাক্য গঠন করে উত্তর লিখতে হবে।

প্রশ্ন ৩: Gap Filling Without Clues-এ কি পুরো বাক্য লিখতে হবে?

উত্তর: শুধু ক্রমিক নম্বর দিয়ে (a), (b), (c), (d), (e) এর সঠিক শব্দ লিখলেই চলে। তবে পুরো বাক্য তুলে শূন্যস্থানের নিচে দাগ দিয়ে লিখলে খাতার মান আকর্ষণীয় হয়।

প্রশ্ন ৪: MCQ-তে সর্বোচ্চ নম্বর নিশ্চিত করার উপায় কী?

উত্তর: শব্দার্থ ও সিনোনিম-অ্যান্টোনিম প্যাসেজের কনটেক্সট অনুসারে যাচাই করতে হবে। খাতায় লেখার সময় অপশন নম্বর ও সঠিক উত্তর উভয়ই লিখবেন (যেমন: (a) (ii) Carbon dioxide)।

এসএসসি ২০২৭ ইংরেজি ১ম পত্র স্টাডি সিলো সিরিজ (SSC 2027 English Study Silo Series)

জাতীয় শিক্ষাক্রমের পূর্ণাঙ্গ সিলেবাস ও প্রশ্নভিত্তিক ধারাবাহিক প্রস্তুতি নির্দেশিকাসমূহ ক্রমানুসারে পড়ুন:

  • পিলার হাব: SSC English 1st Paper Suggestion 2027 (মাস্টার হাব ও মানবণ্টন)
  • Part 01: SSC 2027 English Seen Passage Suggestion (সিন প্যাসেজ MCQ ও প্রশ্নোত্তর) (এই পোস্ট)
  • Part 02: SSC 2027 English Unseen Passage & Summary Suggestion (আনসিন ও সামারি)
  • Part 03: SSC 2027 English Matching & Rearrange Suggestion (ম্যাচিং টেবিল ও রি-অ্যারেঞ্জ)
  • Part 04: SSC 2027 English Poems & Stories Suggestion (কবিতা ও গল্প প্রশ্নোত্তর)

item.title: SSC English 1st Paper Suggestion 2027 | এসএসসি ২০২৭ ইংরেজি ১ম পত্র চূড়ান্ত সাজেশন ও মানবণ্টন (PDF)
item.dc:creator: ayesha
item.content:encoded:
SSC & Dakhil Exam 2027 | English 1st Paper (Subject Code: 136) | Full Marks: 100
Figure: SSC & Dakhil 2027 English 1st Paper (Subject Code: 136) 100 Marks Syllabus & Suggestion Guide

Quick Overview (সারসংক্ষেপ): বাংলাদেশ শিক্ষা বোর্ড ও জাতীয় শিক্ষাক্রম ও পাঠ্যপুস্তক বোর্ড (NCTB) অনুমোদিত নতুন কারিকুলাম অনুসারে SSC English 1st Paper Suggestion 2027 (Subject Code: 136) পরীক্ষা ১০০ নম্বরের পূর্ণাঙ্গ সিলেবাসে অনুষ্ঠিত হতে যাচ্ছে। ঢাকা, রাজশাহী, চট্টগ্রাম, কুমিল্লাসহ সকল সাধারণ শিক্ষা বোর্ড এবং বাংলাদেশ মাদ্রাসা শিক্ষা বোর্ডের দাখিল পরীক্ষার্থীদের জন্য এই গাইডটিতে SSC 2027 English 1st Paper Syllabus and Marks Distribution পুঙ্খানুপুঙ্খভাবে বিশ্লেষণ করা হয়েছে। পরীক্ষাটি মূলত দুটি প্রধান বিভাগে বিভক্ত—Part A: Reading (70 Marks) এবং Part B: Writing (30 Marks)। এখানে অন্তর্ভুক্ত রয়েছে পাঠ্যবই English For Today-এর Seen Comprehension (MCQ, Questions, Gap Filling), Unseen Passage & Summary Writing, Sentence Matching Table, Re-arranging Sentences, সাহিত্য অংশের Poems ও Stories এবং রাইটিং অংশের Completing Story ও Dialogue Writing। পরীক্ষায় শতভাগ কমন ও এ-প্লাস (A+) নিশ্চিত করতে নিচে প্রতিটি প্রশ্নের জন্য নির্ভরযোগ্য মডেল প্রশ্ন ও পূর্ণাঙ্গ হ্যান্ডনোট সাজিয়ে দেওয়া হলো।

📌 এসএসসি ও দাখিল ২০২৬-২০২৭ পরীক্ষার্থীদের জন্য বিশেষ নির্দেশনা:

ইংরেজি বিষয়ের সেরা প্রস্তুতির পাশাপাশি বাংলা ১ম পত্রে পূর্ণাঙ্গ এ-প্লাস নিশ্চিত করতে আমাদের নতুন SSC বাংলা ১ম পত্র চূড়ান্ত সাজেশন, ১০০ নম্বরের মডেল টেস্ট ও প্রশ্নব্যাংক ২০২৭ (১০০% বোর্ড কমন) দেখে নাও।

Table of Contents (সূচিপত্র)
  • ১. এসএসসি ২০২৭ ইংরেজি ১ম পত্র সিলেবাস ও মানবণ্টন (SSC English 1st Paper Marks Distribution & Syllabus 2027)
  • ২. পার্ট-এ: রিডিং অংশ ৭০ নম্বর সাজেশন (Part A: Reading 70 Marks Exclusive Suggestion)
    • প্রশ্ন ১-৩: সিন প্যাসেজ (Seen Comprehension — MCQ, Questions & Gap Filling - 22 Marks)
    • প্রশ্ন ৪-৫: আনসিন প্যাসেজ ও সামারি (Unseen Passage & Summary Writing - 15 Marks)
    • প্রশ্ন ৬: সেন্টেন্স ম্যাচিং টেবিল (Sentence Matching Table - 5 Marks)
    • প্রশ্ন ৭: রি-অ্যারেঞ্জিং সেন্টেন্সেস (Re-arranging Sentences Shortcut Rules - 8 Marks)
    • প্রশ্ন ৮-৯: কবিতা ও গল্প থেকে প্রশ্নোত্তর (Answering Questions from Poems & Stories - 20 Marks)
  • ৩. পার্ট-বি: রাইটিং অংশ ৩০ নম্বর সাজেশন (Part B: Writing 30 Marks Final Suggestion)
    • প্রশ্ন ১০: কমপ্লিটিং স্টোরি সাজেশন (Completing Story Suggestion for SSC 2027 - 15 Marks)
    • প্রশ্ন ১১: ডায়ালগ রাইটিং সাজেশন (Dialogue Writing Suggestion for SSC 2027 - 15 Marks)
  • ৪. এসএসসি ইংরেজি ১ম পত্রে এ-প্লাস পাওয়ার কৌশল (5 Tested Tips to Score GPA 5 in SSC English 1st Paper)
  • ৫. সম্পূর্ণ ১০০ নম্বরের হ্যান্ডনোট পিডিএফ ডাউনলোড (SSC English 1st Paper Full Suggestion & Handnote PDF Download)
  • ৬. এসএসসি ২০২৭ স্টাডি সাইলো সিরিজ (SSC 2027 English Study Silo Series)
  • ৭. সচরাচর জিজ্ঞাসিত প্রশ্ন (Frequently Asked Questions - FAQ)

১. এসএসসি ২০২৭ ইংরেজি ১ম পত্র সিলেবাস ও মানবণ্টন (SSC English 1st Paper Marks Distribution & Syllabus 2027)

মাধ্যমিক ও উচ্চমাধ্যমিক শিক্ষা বোর্ড (ঢাকা, চট্টগ্রাম, রাজশাহী, যশোর, বরিশাল, সিলেট, দিনাজপুর, কুমিল্লা, ময়মনসিংহ) এবং বাংলাদেশ মাদ্রাসা শিক্ষা বোর্ডের অধীনে অনুষ্ঠিতব্য ২০২৭ সালের এসএসসি ও দাখিল পরীক্ষায় ইংরেজি ১ম পত্রে কোনো সংক্ষিপ্ত সিলেবাস থাকছে না। শিক্ষার্থীদের মূল পাঠ্যবই English For Today (EFT) এবং বাস্তবভিত্তিক গ্রামাটিক্যাল ও রাইটিং দক্ষতার ওপর সম্পূর্ণ ১০০ নম্বরের ভিত্তিতে লিখিত মূল্যায়ন করা হবে।

পরীক্ষায় সর্বোচ্চ নম্বর অর্জনের প্রথম ধাপ হলো প্রশ্নপদ্ধতি ও প্রতিটি প্রশ্নের জন্য বরাদ্দকৃত নম্বরের বণ্টন নিখুঁতভাবে জানা। নিচে ২০২৭ সালের সর্বশেষ প্রশ্নকাঠামো ও মানবণ্টন ছক আকারে তুলে ধরা হলো:

Skill Area (দক্ষতার ক্ষেত্র) Test Items (প্রশ্ন নম্বর ও আইটেমের নাম) Question Type & Source (প্রশ্নের ধরন) Marks (নির্ধারিত নম্বর)
Part A: Reading (70 Marks) Question 1: Multiple Choice Questions (MCQ) Seen Comprehension 1 (১ম সিন প্যাসেজ) 1 x 7 = 7 Marks
Question 2: Answering Questions (Open-ended) Seen Comprehension 1 (১ম সিন প্যাসেজ) 2 x 5 = 10 Marks
